    Welfare

    Free sanitary products and condoms

    Ask your faculty's student committee or the Student Union room for free sanitary products, and use the NHSO condom dispenser on the 1st floor of the Student Activity Building.

    Last reviewed: 22 November 2026

    • FreeSanitary products
    • FreeCondoms, from the dispenser on the 1st floor of the Student Activity Building

    Sanitary products

    Ask for free sanitary products from your faculty's student committee, or from the Student Union room.

    Condoms

    Condoms are from the National Health Security Office (NHSO) dispenser on the 1st floor of the Student Activity Building.

    The location of the Student Union room and of your faculty committee's office is not published. Find a faculty office in the directory, or a place on the map in places.
